content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Authorize DocumentLink ## slug: authorize-documentlink ## seoTitle: Authorize DocumentLink ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End In order to view your Order or Invoice via {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}}, you must oauth with Blackthorn's Connect App. :::(Warning) (**Oauth Link**) In order for the authorization to work properly, you can only be logged into one Salesforce org. ::: **Production Org** Please click the [oauth link](https://auth.blackthorn.io/salesforce?packages=03361000000DksxAAC){target="_blank"} to complete the DocumentLink setup. Once you authorize with the key above, you will be set. **Sandbox Org** {{snippet.DocumentLink_AuthorizeSandbox}} :::(Info) () If you receive an error with DocumentLink, click to view [Error Codes And Messages](/v1/docs/documentlink-error-codes-and-messages). :::
